description: Source file implementing the QhullFacetSet class, which manages linked facets in Qhull's computational geometry algorithms. Contains class methods, global operator overloads, and conversions related to Qhull facets.

classes.name: QhullFacetSet
classes.description: A class representing a set of linked facets in Qhull, with methods for conversion, containment, and counting.

methods.name: toStdVector
methods.description: Converts the QhullFacetSet to a standard vector of QhullFacet objects.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific QhullFacet is in the set.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of facets in the set, optionally filtered by a specific facet.
